shared_elements: low-relief carving on a large upright stone slab/pillar
horizontal band of repeated motifs across the upper portion
abstract or schematic geometric signs alongside figures
justification: Both surfaces are upright slabs bearing low-relief imagery divided into an upper register of repeated, roughly identical motifs above a lower zone with profile creatures and scattered schematic signs, which gives a loose compositional echo. But the specific content differs entirely: A shows a crowded, curvilinear, interlocking mass of figures with a large volute and blocky glyph-like panels, while B shows widely spaced, isolated animals (a crouching quadruped, a long-necked bird, a bird with outstretched wing) against a bare field, rendered in a much sparser, flatter, more silhouette-like manner.
